title: Dataobject specializes Dataobject
description: A data object is a subtype of another data object: it carries every field of the general one and adds or narrows some, so an instance of it is also an instance of the general one.
x-dr-evidence: A TypeScript interface or type extending another (interface ImportResult extends BaseResult), or a data class deriving from another data class, both classified as application data objects; CBM INHERITS.
